notes: Paper constrains axion-photon coupling g_agamma via stimulated axion decay in the Bullet Cluster using 1.1-3.1 GHz radio data. Pre-analysis hint of DarkPhoton is incorrect; the paper's exclusion is explicitly on g_agamma (GeV^-1). Data taken from Table 2: 2-sigma upper limits of the two-component (cosmic-ray + axion decay) model, evaluated at the mean ma of each sub-band (14-17, 17-20, 20-23, 23-26, 26-29, 29-32 ueV). No local DM density assumption applies (cluster-scale bound using cluster virial mass M=3.1e15 Msun). The paper also reports a conservative limit ~(2.3-5.3)e-11 GeV^-1 and a tentative best-fit signal at ma~15.3 ueV, but the main quoted limits are the Table 2 values. | selector: table (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
